Knowing what type of input and output signals are in the circuit will help you determine whether or not the system is operating correctly.
Using integrated circuits makes circuit analysis and maintenance very easy.
In fact, both the modulator and demodulator circuits are contained on one PC card with room to spare.
Integrated circuits take up less room and consume less power than discrete circuits.
In this lesson you should observe the operation of a FM transmitter and receiver circuit that uses integrated circuits.
